description: X-OOS-Actor v1 test vector (spec 2026-11-07-native-cms-in-the-builder-design 5.2). target is the canonical target of the platform request: its pathname, then '?' and its query pairs sorted by key (a stable sort in code-unit order) and serialised by URLSearchParams, the '?' and pairs only when there is a pair. p is base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of target; h is base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 over the body bytes (empty for this GET). payloadSegment is base64url (no padding) of the UTF-8 JSON of payload, keys in the order aud, org, sub, sid, m, p, h, jti, iat, exp, ip; mac is base64url (no padding) of HMAC-SHA256 keyed by secret over the ASCII bytes of payloadSegment; header is v1. + payloadSegment + . + mac. iat and exp are Unix seconds. The secret is a test value only; it is never the preview or the site-action secret.
